title: 隧道管片防水墊圈安裝
summary: 本課聚焦把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」與「水頭與試驗壓差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Compression and groove geometry" and "Water head and test differential": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Compression and groove geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」如何影響隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compression and groove geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Segmental-lining gasket installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。應以實際溝槽和接縫幾何計算，名義墊高不能單獨代表安裝後接觸狀態。 假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。 溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact. Insufficient compression leaves paths, while excessive compression can damage rubber or concrete. Actual groove and joint geometry, not nominal gasket height alone, governs installed contact. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product. An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compression and groove geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compression and groove geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何
knowledge.text: 止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。應以實際溝槽和接縫幾何計算，名義墊高不能單獨代表安裝後接觸狀態。
knowledge.textEn: A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact. Insufficient compression leaves paths, while excessive compression can damage rubber or concrete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compression and groove geometry" is correct?
options: 只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。
止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。
短時間不漏水就保證所有老化和變形情境都合格。
optionsEn: Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio.
A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact.
Brief absence of leakage proves adequacy under every aging and deformation scenario.
quiz.explanation: 止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compression and groove geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compression and groove geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compression and groove geometry", which statement holds?
options: 止水墊反力越大越好，不必檢查混凝土溝槽劈裂。
直線墊條試驗合格就可以省略全部角部交會試驗。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Greater gasket reaction is always better without checking concrete groove splitting.
Passing straight-strip tests makes all corner-intersection testing unnecessary.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compression and groove geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compression and groove geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄壓縮量與溝槽幾何的資料來源與適用條件。量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for compression and groove geometry. Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。
knowledge.textEn: Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄壓縮量與溝槽幾何的資料來源與適用條件。量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for compression and groove geometry. Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compression and groove geometry"?
options: 量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
夾雜硬顆粒時增加閉合力必定能恢復完整止水。
optionsEn: Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Increasing closure force always restores complete sealing when hard debris is trapped.
quiz.explanation: 量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compression and groove geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compression and groove geometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。
knowledge.textEn: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compression and groove geometry" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。
短時間不漏水就保證所有老化和變形情境都合格。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths.
Brief absence of leakage proves adequacy under every aging and deformation scenario.
quiz.explanation: 溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水頭與試驗壓差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water head and test differential: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水頭與試驗壓差」如何影響隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water head and test differential” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Segmental-lining gasket installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水密需求取決於地下水頭、內外壓及局部高度，不只是隧道埋深。試驗壓差須代表核准設計情境並保留溫度、持時和變形條件，不能把一次短暫不漏水等同全壽期性能。 假設淡水水頭50 m，壓差ρgh=0.4905 MPa；這是教學換算，未含設計裕度及暫態。 忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭與試驗壓差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Watertight demand depends on head, internal-external pressure and elevation, not cover depth alone. An assumed fresh-water head of 50 m gives ρgh=0.4905 MPa, a teaching conversion excluding design allowance and transients. Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands. quiz.question: 關於「水頭與試驗壓差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 水頭與試驗壓差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water head and test differential: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭與試驗壓差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water head and test differential” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭50 m，壓差ρgh=0.4905 MPa；這是教學換算，未含設計裕度及暫態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed fresh-water head of 50 m gives ρgh=0.4905 MPa, a teaching conversion excluding design allowance and transients. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將試驗水壓計與試件高程校正，核對供水側及量測側壓力，觀察持時漏量與接縫幾何；試驗負責人依核准規格判定，不採用本課水頭自訂產品認證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Correct pressure for gauge and specimen elevation and compare supply and measured sides while monitoring duration, leakage and gap geometry; test leads apply the approved specification, not an improvised product certification based on this example.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 水頭與試驗壓差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water head and test differential: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭與試驗壓差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water head and test differential” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將試驗水壓計與試件高程校正，核對供水側及量測側壓力，觀察持時漏量與接縫幾何；試驗負責人依核准規格判定，不採用本課水頭自訂產品認證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Correct pressure for gauge and specimen elevation and compare supply and measured sides while monitoring duration, leakage and gap geometry; test leads apply the approved specification, not an improvised product certification based on this example. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄水頭與試驗壓差的資料來源與適用條件。將試驗水壓計與試件高程校正，核對供水側及量測側壓力，觀察持時漏量與接縫幾何；試驗負責人依核准規格判定，不採用本課水頭自訂產品認證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for water head and test differential. Correct pressure for gauge and specimen elevation and compare supply and measured sides while monitoring duration, leakage and gap geometry; test leads apply the approved specification, not an improvised product certification based on this example.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭與試驗壓差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

共同模具偏差可當作彼此獨立的小誤差互相抵消。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.

steps.title: 水頭與試驗壓差：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭與試驗壓差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water head and test differential” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「短時間不漏水就保證所有老化和變形情境都合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Brief absence of leakage proves adequacy under every aging and deformation scenario." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水頭與試驗壓差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water head and test differential" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
縫寬和錯台分別合格就代表任何組合都一定水密。
忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Separate gap and offset compliance guarantees watertightness for every combination.
Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage.
quiz.explanation: 忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
